title: Ballad of the Homeland of Love (Rwai Ieit Hima)
cultural_context: Lyrical song from H. O. Mawrie's 'Ha Ka Hima Jong Ka Jingieit' expressing selfless devotion, marital fidelity, and spiritual harmony.

khasi: Ha ka hima jong ka jingieit ba shisha,
Kam don ka sarong ne ka jingmut ar-sap;
Kawei ka dohnud kawei ka jingthrang,
Kum ka um ba tuid na kliar lum,
Ba pynpyngngad ia man uba sliang;
Ba pynim ia ka ri baroh.
english: In the true realm of authentic love,
There is no pride nor double-dealing mind;
One common heart, one harmonious desire,
To bring comfort unto fellow humankind;
Like the clear stream flowing from mountain heights,
Quenching the thirst of every weary wanderer;
It is this sacred divine love
That gives life to the whole motherland.

khasi: Lada ngi im ha kane ka jingieit,
Ka iing jong ngi kan long kum ka bneng;
Ki khun ki kti kin san ha ka akor,
Kin bat ia ka hok ba la buh ki kpa;
Ha pneh ka Mei-ri ngin shong suk,
Khlem da don ba lah ban pynpait;
Ka jingieit ba shisha kan iaineh
Kum u khlur ba tyngshain junom.
english: If we abide in this sacred love,
Our home shall be a haven like heaven;
Our children shall grow in noble etiquette,
Holding fast to truth bequeathed by the fathers;
In the lap of our Motherland we shall dwell in peace,
With none possessing power to divide our bond;
Like the star that shines throughout eternity.
